definitions.gloss: day shift; daytime work; daytime duty
definitions.explanation: Working during the daytime hours, as opposed to night shifts. Common in workplaces that operate around the clock, such as hospitals, factories, and security.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日勤|にっきん}だ。
examples.english: I'm on the day shift today.

examples.japanese: {日勤|にっきん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{夜勤|やきん}→夜勤：09549_yakin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交代|こうたい}→交代：14943_koutai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦やっている→やる：02980_yaru⟧。
examples.english: I alternate between day shifts and night shifts.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれて→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日勤|にっきん}⟦のみ→のみ：06546_nomi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{勤務|きんむ}→勤務：04545_kinmu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}えて→変える：01089_kaeru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: After my child was born, I had my schedule changed to day shifts only.

notes:
{日勤|にっきん} refers to working during daytime hours, as opposed to night shifts. It is mainly used in workplaces that operate around the clock, such as hospitals, factories, and security.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日勤|にっきん}⟦{帯|たい}→〜帯：30366_tai⟧: day shift hours
- {日勤|にっきん}⟦{専属|せんぞく}→専属：15844_senzoku⟧: day shift only (permanent days)
- {日勤|にっきん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{夜勤|やきん}→夜勤：09549_yakin⟧: day shift and night shift

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{夜勤|やきん}→夜勤：09549_yakin⟧: night shift (opposite)

RELATED SHIFT TERMS:
- ⟦{早番|はやばん}→早番：17358_hayaban⟧: early shift
- ⟦{遅番|おそばん}→遅番：18818_osoban⟧: late shift
- {当直|とうちょく}: overnight duty
- ⟦{交代|こうたい}→交代：14943_koutai⟧⟦{勤務|きんむ}→勤務：04545_kinmu⟧: shift work
